table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	dbo.item.icode , 
	dbo.item.customicode, 
	currqty = Case When sum(GD.currqty) IS NULL Then 0 Else sum(GD.currqty) End, 
	minqty=dbo.item.minqty,  
	dbo.item.optimumqty,
	dbo.item.reorderqty, 
	dbo.item.purprice,
	packunits=dbo.item.packunits,
	item=dbo.item.name,  
	Manufacturer=dbo.Manufacturer.name,
	ItemCategory=dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	ItemClass=dbo.ItemClass.name,
	ItemPacking=(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.Packcode = dbo.item.packcode),
	genericitem=(SELECT genericitem.name FROM genericitem WHERE genericitem.genericCode = dbo.item.genericCode),
	transitstock = ISNULL(dbo.item.transitstock, 0),
	LastPurInvCode = (SELECT MAX(P.PurInvCode) FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P WHERE D.ICode = Item.ICode AND P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.Posted='Y'),
	LastPurDate = (SELECT MAX(P.Date) FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P WHERE D.ICode = Item.ICode AND P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.Posted='Y'),
	gstperc=dbo.item.gstperc1,
	packsalestax=dbo.item.packsalestax,
	purprice=dbo.item.purprice,
	saleprice=dbo.item.saleprice,
	rpp=dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	packavgprice=ROUND(dbo.item.avgprice * dbo.item.packunits, 2)

FROM 
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT GDD.* FROM dbo.godowndetail GDD WHERE GDD.GCode IN (SELECT G.GCode FROM Godown G WHERE G.ConsiderStockINPO='Y')) AS GD ON (dbo.item.icode = GD.icode),
	dbo.Manufacturer,
	dbo.itemcategory,
	dbo.itemclass,
	(SELECT ManfCode 
	FROM Manufacturer
	WHERE
		ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
		POPolicyCode IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
			FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
			WHERE 
				CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
				CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
				CPD.WeekOfMonth IN 
					(SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) M
WHERE
	dbo.Fn_GetPreference('fetchlastpurinfoinpo')='Y' AND
	( dbo.item.manfcode = m.manfcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.optimumqty > 0 ) AND
	( dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICatCode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICCode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.Active = 1 ) AND
	( DBO.item.GeneratePO = 'Y' )

GROUP BY 
	dbo.item.icode , 
	dbo.item.manfcode, 
	dbo.item.minqty,  
	dbo.item.optimumqty, 
	dbo.item.reorderqty, 
	dbo.item.purprice, 
	dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.item.saleprice,
	dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	dbo.item.avgprice,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.Manufacturer.Name,
	dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	dbo.ItemClass.name,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.transitstock,
	dbo.item.packcode,
	dbo.item.genericcode,
	dbo.item.gstperc1,
	dbo.item.packsalestax
HAVING
   ( dbo.item.reorderqty > 
		(Case When sum(GD.currqty) IS NULL Then 0 Else sum(GD.currqty) End + ISNULL(dbo.item.transitstock, 0)) )
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	dbo.item.icode , 
	dbo.item.customicode, 
	currqty = Case When sum(GD.currqty) IS NULL Then 0 Else sum(GD.currqty) End, 
	minqty=dbo.item.minqty,  
	dbo.item.optimumqty,
	dbo.item.reorderqty, 
	dbo.item.purprice,
	packunits=dbo.item.packunits,
	item=dbo.item.name,  
	Manufacturer=dbo.Manufacturer.name,
	ItemCategory=dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	ItemClass=dbo.ItemClass.name,
	ItemPacking=(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.Packcode = dbo.item.packcode),
	genericitem=(SELECT genericitem.name FROM genericitem WHERE genericitem.genericCode = dbo.item.genericCode),
	transitstock = ISNULL(dbo.item.transitstock, 0),
	LastPurInvCode = NULL,
	LastPurDate = NULL,
	gstperc=dbo.item.gstperc1,
	packsalestax=dbo.item.packsalestax,
	purprice=dbo.item.purprice,
	saleprice=dbo.item.saleprice,
	rpp=dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	packavgprice=ROUND(dbo.item.avgprice * dbo.item.packunits, 2)

FROM 
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT GDD.* FROM dbo.godowndetail GDD WHERE GDD.GCode IN (SELECT G.GCode FROM Godown G WHERE G.ConsiderStockINPO='Y')) AS GD ON (dbo.item.icode = GD.icode),
	dbo.Manufacturer,
	dbo.itemcategory,
	dbo.itemclass,
	(SELECT ManfCode 
	FROM Manufacturer
	WHERE
		ManufacturerTypeCode IN (:ai_manftypecode) AND
		POPolicyCode IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT CP.POPolicyCode 
			FROM POPolicy CP, POPolicyDetail CPD
			WHERE 
				CP.POPolicyCode = CPD.POPolicyCode AND
				CPD.WeekDayCode = DatePart(weekday, :ad_orderdate) AND
				CPD.WeekOfMonth IN 
					(SELECT WeekOfMonth=DBO.Fn_WeekDayCountInMonth(:ad_orderdate)))) M
WHERE
	dbo.Fn_GetPreference('fetchlastpurinfoinpo')='N' AND
	( dbo.item.manfcode = m.manfcode ) AND
	( dbo.item.optimumqty > 0 ) AND
	( dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICatCode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICCode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.Active = 1 ) AND
	( DBO.item.GeneratePO = 'Y' )

GROUP BY 
	dbo.item.icode , 
	dbo.item.manfcode, 
	dbo.item.minqty,  
	dbo.item.optimumqty, 
	dbo.item.reorderqty, 
	dbo.item.purprice, 
	dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.item.saleprice,
	dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	dbo.item.avgprice,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.Manufacturer.Name,
	dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	dbo.ItemClass.name,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.transitstock,
	dbo.item.packcode,
	dbo.item.genericcode,
	dbo.item.gstperc1,
	dbo.item.packsalestax
HAVING
   ( dbo.item.reorderqty > 
		(Case When sum(GD.currqty) IS NULL Then 0 Else sum(GD.currqty) End + ISNULL(dbo.item.transitstock, 0)) )
ORDER BY manufacturer, item
